key_derivation: Because mix.exs:60 sets elixirc_paths to ["lib"] and mix.exs:46-49 excludes test/support and test/fixtures from discovery, nothing under them is autoloaded -- the only loading mechanisms are Code.require_file and direct File.read!. `git grep -n 'Code.require_file' -- test/` enumerates them exhaustively: 16 of the 20 root test files load installer/test/mix_helper.exs by the relative path ../../../installer/test/mix_helper.exs at line 1 (the four that do not are test/mix/phoenix_test.exs, test/mix/tasks/phx.digest.clean_test.exs, test/mix/tasks/phx.gen.auth/injector_test.exs, test/mix/tasks/phx_
